name: Sun Belt Cross Country Championships
headline: Sun Belt Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: App State won the men's title with 21 points, well ahead of Arkansas State (77) and Marshall (91); App State's Thomas Wlazlowski took the individual title in 23:33.3. Louisiana won the women's team race with 46 points over Southern Miss (81) and James Madison (86), while Marshall's Rachael Withrow won the 5K in 16:15.7.
